name: Presheaf.χ_unique
statement: F ⟶ G) (χ' : G ⟶ Functor.sieves C) (hχ' : IsPullback m ((Functor.isTerminalConst _ Types.isTerminalPUnit).from _) χ' (truth C)) : χ' = χ m

name: χ_unique
statement: F ⟶ G) [Mono m] (χ' : G ⟶ Sheaf.Ω J) (hχ' : IsPullback m ((isTerminalTerminal J _).from F) χ' (Sheaf.truth J)) : χ' = Sheaf.χ m
